package.name: trnav_2ws_core
package.description: AMR Motion Core - platform-agnostic abstraction library (TrapezoidalProfile, TransientGuard, LocalizationMonitor, RobotGeometry, RecursiveMovingAverage, math_utils, ActionMutex) for trnav_motion_mux consumers. Platform-specific controllers/packer/ActionServerBase live in trnav_2ws_motion (the DD sibling trnav_motion_dd is not present in this repository) per ADR-012 (2026-05-21); kinematics (IK/BicycleModel) live in trnav_2ws_kinematics under src/Control/Motion_Control/2WS/ (trnav_dd_kinematics is not present) per the 2026-07-04 amendment. In-repo trace of both decisions: docs/amr_motion_core_code_updates.md.
